about: Real-world JSON documents, pinned by upstream commit and sha256. Fetched into perf/e2e/corpus/ (gitignored) by `python3 perf/e2e/bench.py fetch`. None of these files is generated; every one is a public benchmark document or a public dataset.

files.name: github_events
files.shape: GitHub REST API event feed: nested objects, URLs, mixed literals

files.name: apache_builds
files.shape: Jenkins API dump: 884 small uniform objects of short strings (tabular)

files.name: numbers
files.shape: one flat array of 10001 doubles (float-parse/print stress)

files.name: instruments
files.shape: music-app save file: deep objects, many small integers and booleans

files.name: random
files.shape: generated-user records (json-generator): 1000 objects with nested arrays, non-ASCII names

files.name: update_center
files.shape: Jenkins plugin registry: wide objects of strings keyed by plugin name

files.name: twitterescaped
files.shape: twitter.json with every non-ASCII character written as a \u escape

files.name: twitter
files.shape: Twitter search API response: 100 tweets, heavy UTF-8 (CJK), nested user objects

files.name: mesh
files.shape: 3D mesh: arrays of integer indices and short decimals

files.name: jobs
files.shape: US census occupations: 7650 uniform rows with small decimals (tabular)

files.name: football
files.shape: international football results: 6508 uniform rows of strings and ints (tabular)

files.name: earthquakes
files.shape: USGS GeoJSON feed: features with properties, coordinates, URLs

files.name: movies
files.shape: 3201 film records, uniform keys with many nulls (tabular)

files.name: citm_catalog
files.shape: ticketing catalog: maps keyed by numeric ids, integer-heavy, repetitive

files.name: flights_20k
files.shape: 20000 flight rows of 5 fields (the TOON sweet spot: one big uniform table)

files.name: canada
files.shape: GeoJSON border polygon: 111080 high-precision doubles in coordinate pairs

files.name: marine_ik
files.shape: three.js animated model: 245k numbers, half doubles

files.name: gsoc_2018
files.shape: Google Summer of Code 2018 projects: long prose strings, uniform objects

files.name: semanticscholar
files.shape: Semantic Scholar paper records: abstracts, author lists, nested arrays

files.name: flights_200k
files.shape: 200000 flight rows of 3 numeric fields (a large uniform table, one third doubles)
